data_issues: Covariate shift / unit dropout in the test set: 9 of 27 units (indices 0,1,2,11,12,13,14,15,20, several of them the highest-firing units) have zero spikes in every one of the 48 test trials, while they fire normally in train and val. As a result, test trials have ~40% of the total spike count of train trials (~45 vs ~111 spikes per trial). A decoder trained on all units would be badly miscalibrated on test (all-unit CV ~0.6 does not transfer). I dropped those units and trained on the remaining 18. That gives ~0.25 cross-validated accuracy (chance is 0.125). Labels and movie_time_s in train/val are consistent, balanced, and have no duplicate trials.
